author: GamingBolt
description:
This next gen update for Metro: Last Light Redux feels substantial. It goes far beyond just being a visual improvement, to also deliver a game that feels far better to play through than it did 10 years ago. 

It also feels more immersive, which makes the already strong narrative element land even better than it did the first time around. It may not be a perfect game, but it is an experience worth preserving and fans of the FPS genre should be grateful that this update exists.
title: Metro: Last Light Redux Next-Gen Update Review - The Definitive Version

author: GamingBolt
description:
Looking back on this bloodbath of a release window, especially as we enter November, it's interesting to see which titles emerged victorious and which struggled. 

Almost everyone expected that Onimusha: Way of the Sword, The Blood of Dawnwalker, and Control Resonant would top one million sales each. Few expected Star Wars: Zero Company and perhaps even Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve to end up as big as they did. 

And among the biggest names, even fewer expected titles like Gears of War: E-Day to reportedly come up short. That you could substitute other names of varying degrees of size and scope is a testament to how packed this season has been.

Yet, one performed even better than our wildest expectations, and if the headline didn't give it away, it's S-Game's Phantom Blade Zero.
title: Why Are MILLIONS of Gamers Buying Phantom Blade Zero?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown has been a lot of fun to play over the last few days, and the new stories it gives Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane are a part of that charm. We made a beeline for the tales that would serve as neat little bows on the narratives that set up the base game, and we can tell you that they don’t disappoint.

Each one takes the theme of the unknown forward in interesting ways that are relevant to the characters they focus on. And while there are a few hiccups along the way, we couldn’t help but come away satisfied with where each of the new stories left the people at their center. Join us as we tell you all about our time with these tales, and what worked and what didn’t as we went through them.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown's Post-Game Stories Steal The Show
